summary: Chat input: single-line input → auto-grow textarea with max-height scrollbar
description:
The chat input is currently a single-line `<input>` element. Long queries scroll horizontally inside a one-line field and become unreadable. Most chat apps (Slack, Discord, ChatGPT, WhatsApp web) use a textarea that auto-grows up to a max height, then scrolls. This ticket converts the input.

Behavior:
- Replace the `<input>` at src/app/(app)/chat/page.tsx with a `<textarea>`.
- Min-height matches today's single-line height (no visual regression on first paint).
- Auto-grow on input: a useLayoutEffect that resets height to 'auto' and sets it to min(scrollHeight, maxHeight) on every value change.
- Max height ≈ 160px desktop / 144px mobile (~6 lines), then `overflow-y: auto` engages a scrollbar.
- `resize: none` so the user can't drag-resize.
- Keep existing keyboard behavior: Enter sends, Shift+Enter inserts a newline. (Future ticket may flip this on mobile to match WhatsApp/iMessage conventions; out of scope here.)
- Ships in the same PR as 84ac8169 (char counter), since both touch the same input.

No tests — purely visual + DOM behavior; the suite has no React component tests today and adding a JSDOM harness for a visual change is out of scope.

resolution.note: Auto-grow textarea, max 160px desktop / 144px mobile, scrolls beyond. Enter sends, Shift+Enter newline. Same Enter-sends behavior as before; mobile newline UX (Enter inserts newline, only Send button submits) flagged in the description as a possible future ticket but out of scope here.
